contact.whatsappMessage: Hello Agri HiTech Kisan, I need help with the platform.

assistant.name: Kisan Sahayak
assistant.welcome: Namaste! I can help you explore products, brands, government schemes, mandi bhav, nearby dealers, registrations, and subscriptions. What would you like to know?
assistant.fallback: I could not find an exact answer for that. Try Products, Mandi Bhav, Anudan Yojana, Nearby Dealers, Registration, or Contact Support.

topics.answer: Browse agricultural products by category or brand. Sign in when you want to view protected product and nearby-seller details.
Our categories help you quickly find seeds, crop-care products, farm inputs, and other agricultural products.
Explore registered agricultural brands and companies, then open a brand to see its available products.
Check current mandi bhav and commodity prices to stay informed before buying or selling crops.
Explore government Anudan Yojana information, including benefits, eligibility, application process, and required documents. Scheme pages are public and do not require login.
Allow location access and sign in to see nearby registered dealers, distance, availability, and seller contact details for a product.
Read the latest agriculture, crop, policy, and monsoon updates from the News section.
Choose Customer to sign in as a farmer using your registered mobile number. After login, you can access protected product and dealer details and manage your profile.
Register as a B2B dealer with firm, proprietor, category, brand, and location details. Dealers can manage assigned brands and products and use the B2B marketplace.
Register a company account to manage your brands, products, dealers, profile, and subscription from the company dashboard.
Dealer and company accounts can review available plans, current subscription status, expiry dates, and subscription history from their dashboards.
Our support team is available by phone or WhatsApp. You can also use the Contact page to send a message.
Namaste! How can I help you with Agri HiTech Kisan today?
